summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited (NASDAQ: SUPX), a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the launch of its AI Token Platform and AI Apps at Tech Week Singapore 2026, held September 29-30, 2026 at Marina Bay Sands. The platform offers unified multi-model access to over 100 AI models from more than 10 providers via an OpenAI-compatible API, while AI Apps targets professional content creation workflows. No transaction, securities offering, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present; the filing is an ordinary product announcement with no deal terms to arbitrage.
